highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Located in France, JUNIA is the School of Science and Engineering of Lille Catholic University, France’s largest private not-for-profit university since 1875. The school also offers research and business services, specialising in agricultural science, food science, environmental science, and agricultural economics.

JUNIA was also among the first French higher education institutions to offer programs that were completely taught in English.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
At JUNIA, you’ll be in a vibrant student community of over 40,000 students, from around 65 nationalities.

JUNIA’s Student Union organises and leads the social life. You can join over 100 student associations and clubs at the school. Some of these include fine arts, cinema, photography, video, entrepreneurship clubs, and many more.

What’s more, you can also enrol in intensive French language and intercultural communication courses at JUNIA, with more than 30 programs to choose from.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
JUNIA does not provide accommodation on campus. However, the school has partnered with housing providers to give you various accommodation options, ranging from private ones to shared spaces.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Sports
The JUNIA Sports Association is in charge of sports activities. You can choose from over 40 sports, including football, volleyball, basketball, rugby, handball, futsal, tennis, horse riding, archery, badminton, athletics, sailing, swimming, and many more.

Laboratory
JUNIA has two Fab Labs–open and collaborative workshops for students. These spaces are filled with laser cutters, 3D printers, and various tools that allow you to create prototypes for engineering courses and projects.

Cafeteria
The Lille Catholic University cafeteria is located at the heart of JUNIA’s main campus and is open for lunch and dinner. Additionally, you can use the student lounge as a dining area during lunch breaks. There are also many shops and restaurants in the neighbourhood.
